title: Perform String Shifts
summary: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters and a matrix of shift operations, where each operation is defined by a direction (0 for a left shift and 1 for a right shift) and an amount, apply the specified shifts to s .
statement: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters and a matrix of shift operations, where each operation is defined by a direction (0 for a left shift and 1 for a right shift) and an amount, apply the specified shifts to s . A left shift moves the first character of s to the end, and a right shift moves the last character to the beginning. Return the resulting string after all shifts have been applied.
constraints: Each [0,amount] shifts left and [1,amount] shifts right.
Apply all operations and return the final string.
hints: All rotations compose, so sum signed amounts first.
Treat right as positive and left as negative.
Reduce the net shift modulo the string length.
One final slice rotation has the same effect as the full operation sequence.
editorial: One final slice rotation has the same effect as the full operation sequence.

tests.explanation: The net movement is one position right, producing cab.
The operations combine to a net right rotation of three.
